verdict.rationale: New Relic offers some at-scale mechanisms. Terraform-based Agent Control is described as a declarative way of 'managing fleets of agents at scale'. The CLI can search entities across all accounts, manage entity tags and run in CI/CD pipelines. NerdGraph can configure some features programmatically. None of this documents true bulk operations, so applying one action across many items generally means scripting it yourself. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch edit operations (e.g., bulk tagging, bulk alert or entity updates), bulk support via the MCP server or AI assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
